name: Fiber Optic Components and Devices
description: Review of optical fiber properties: step and graded index fibers, multimode, single mode, birefringent, photonic crystal and holey fiber; directional couplers: analysis, fabrication and characterization: fused and polished fiber couplers application in power dividers, wavelength division multiplexing, interleavers and loop mirrors; fiber half-block devices and application in polarizers, and wavelength filters; fiber grating: short and long period gratings, analysis, fabrication and characterization; applications of fiber gratings in add-drop multiplexing, gain flattening, dispersion compensation and wavelength locking and sensing; polarization effects in optical fibers, fiber polarization components: fiber optic wave-plates, polarization controllers and associated micro-optic components like isolators and circulators; optical fiber sensors: intensity, phase, polarization and wavelength-shift based sensors, applications in various disciplines; nonlinear fiber optic devices like self-phase modulation, all optical switching, solitons; modal analysis of planar waveguides: dielectric waveguides, metal-dielectric plasmonic waveguides, fabrication and characterization of waveguides; modal analysis of channel waveguides for silicon photonics, applications of waveguides as switches, splitters, modulators, polarizers, resonators, sensors, etc.
